quote: Since 2009, an epizootic with acute gill hemorrhages and high mortality has outbroken in cultured gibel carp
statement: 自2009年以来，养殖鲫鱼中爆发了伴有急性鳃出血和高死亡率的流行病。

text_en: Deaths of Clone H began on day 6 post-infection, and by day 14 post-infection, about half of the individuals (51.11%) had died.

quote: Clone F was moderately resistant and 86.67% infected individuals died at 13 dpi.

text_en: Clone F has moderate resistance, with a mortality rate of 86.67% among infected individuals on day 13 post-infection.

quote: The injected fish from clone H had an average viral load of 10 1.88 and 10 2.16 particles/ng DNA at 3 dpi and 5 dpi respectively, markedly less than those in clone A + and F which had an average viral load of 10 3.29 and 10 2.72 at 3 dpi, and 10 4.49 and 10 3.04 at 5 dpi respectively.
statement: 克隆H注射鱼在感染后第3天和第5天的平均病毒载量显著低于克隆A+和F。

text_en: The average viral load of fish injected with Clone H was significantly lower than that of Clone A+ and F on days 3 and 5 post-infection.

quote: In comparison with normal tissue of WT, Ca HV infection resulted in severe necrotic lesion, serious vacuolization and hypertrophied nuclei with karyorrhexis in head-kidney (Fig. 1e).
statement: 与野生型正常组织相比，Ca HV感染导致头肾出现严重的坏死性病变、空泡化和核碎裂肥大。
text_zh: 与野生型正常组织相比，Ca HV感染导致头肾出现严重的坏死性病变、空泡化和核碎裂肥大。
text_en: Compared to normal tissues of wild-type fish, Ca HV infection caused severe necrotic lesions, vacuolization, and karyomegalic hypertrophy in the head kidney.

quote: These results indicate that clone H possesses stronger resistance to herpesvirus infection.
statement: 结果表明克隆H对疱疹病毒感染具有更强的抵抗力。
text_zh: 结果表明克隆H对疱疹病毒感染具有更强的抵抗力。
text_en: The results showed that clone H had stronger resistance to herpesvirus infection.

quote: the association between single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) of immune-related genes (IL-10a and MHC class IIB) and resistance to the cyprinid herpesvirus-3 (Cy HV-3) had been revealed in common carp
statement: 普通鲤鱼中免疫相关基因（IL-10a和MHC类IIB）的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与对鲤疱疹病毒3型（Cy HV-3）的抗性之间的关联已被揭示。

text_en: The association between single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in immune-related genes (IL-10a and MHC class IIB) in common carp and resistance to Cyprinid herpesvirus 3 (Cy HV-3) has been revealed.

quote: Recently, it has been detected in many main culture regions of gibel carp [ 74 ] and caused huge economic loss.

text_en: CyHV-2 has recently been detected in many main culture regions of gibel carp and caused huge economic loss.

quote: After exposing to Ca HV, several pathways, “cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction” including IFNs, interleukins and chemokines, “Toll-like receptor signaling pathway” and “Jak-STAT signaling pathway” responsible for recognizing viral production or activating ISGs, were up-regulated in all three gibel carp clones (Fig. 4b ; Additional file 8 : Table S5), which clearly indicates that IFN response involves in common immune reaction of gibel carp to Ca HV invasion.
statement: 暴露于CaHV后，所有三个银鲫克隆中与识别病毒产物或激活ISG相关的多种通路均上调，表明IFN反应参与银鲫对CaHV入侵的共同免疫反应。
text_zh: 暴露于CaHV后，所有三个银鲫克隆中与识别病毒产物或激活ISG相关的多种通路均上调，表明IFN反应参与银鲫对CaHV入侵的共同免疫反应。
text_en: After exposure to CaHV, multiple pathways related to recognizing viral products or activating ISGs were upregulated in all three Carassius auratus gibelio clones, indicating that the IFN response is involved in the common immune response of C. auratus gibelio to CaHV invasion.

quote: Consistence with KEGG pathway mapping analysis, a lot of IFN system genes, including IFNγ , IFNphi2 , IFI35 , IFI44-like , IFI56 , IFI58 , Mx1 , Mx3 , MxE , viperin , Gig1 , Gig2 and GBP1 , were up-regulated in all three clones (Additional file 9 : Table S6), indicating that IFN-mediated innate immune response is one of major common immune defenses of gibel carp to Ca H
statement: 与KEGG通路映射分析一致，大量IFN系统基因在所有三个克隆中均上调，表明IFN介导的先天免疫反应是银鲫对抗CaH的主要共同免疫防御之一。
text_zh: 与KEGG通路映射分析一致，大量IFN系统基因在所有三个克隆中均上调，表明IFN介导的先天免疫反应是银鲫对抗CaH的主要共同免疫防御之一。
text_en: Consistent with KEGG pathway mapping analysis, a large number of IFN system genes were upregulated in all three clones, indicating that the IFN-mediated innate immune response is one of the major common immune defenses of gibel carp against CaHV.

quote: 1 Heterogeneity and different susceptibility to Ca HV among three gibel carp clones.
statement: 三个银鲫克隆对鲤疱疹病毒（Ca HV）表现出异质性和不同的易感性。
text_zh: 三个银鲫克隆对鲤疱疹病毒（Ca HV）表现出异质性和不同的易感性。
text_en: Three silver crucian carp clones showed heterogeneity and different susceptibility to Cyprinid herpesvirus (Ca HV).

quote: Symptoms in diseased fish. Hyperemia at the base of the fins and on the abdomen (black arrows), bleeding gills and internal organ hemorrhaging.
statement: 患病鱼的症状包括鳍基部和腹部充血、鳃出血以及内脏出血。
text_zh: 患病鱼的症状包括鳍基部和腹部充血、鳃出血以及内脏出血。
text_en: Symptoms of diseased fish include congestion at the base of the fins and abdomen, gill hemorrhage, and visceral hemorrhage.

quote: After Ca HV infection, the diseased fishes first showed sub-clinical symptoms, including lethargy, anorexia and body color deepened.
statement: 感染Ca HV后，患病鱼首先出现亚临床症状，包括嗜睡、厌食和体色加深。
text_zh: 感染Ca HV后，患病鱼首先出现亚临床症状，包括嗜睡、厌食和体色加深。
text_en: After infection with Ca HV, diseased fish first exhibit subclinical symptoms, including lethargy, anorexia, and darkening of body color.

quote: As the disease progresses, they exhibited bleeding at the base of fins and on abdomen, observed pale gills, internal organ hemorrhaging, pink ascites in abdominal cavity and swollen spleen and kidneys (Fig. 1c).
statement: 随着病情进展，鱼只表现出鳍基部和腹部出血、鳃苍白、内脏出血、腹腔粉色腹水以及脾脏和肾脏肿胀。
text_zh: 随着病情进展，鱼只表现出鳍基部和腹部出血、鳃苍白、内脏出血、腹腔粉色腹水以及脾脏和肾脏肿胀。
text_en: As the disease progresses, fish exhibit hemorrhage at the fin bases and abdomen, pale gills, visceral hemorrhage, pink ascites in the abdominal cavity, and swelling of the spleen and kidneys.

quote: Healthy fish showed no pathological changes, while Ca HV infected fish showed that the head-kidney appeared necrotic lesions (asterisk), serious vacuolization (black triangle), and hypertrophied nuclei with karyorrhexis (blue triangle).
statement: 健康鱼没有病理变化，而感染Ca HV的鱼头部肾脏出现坏死病变、严重空泡化以及核碎裂导致的细胞核肥大。
text_zh: 健康鱼没有病理变化，而感染Ca HV的鱼头部肾脏出现坏死病变、严重空泡化以及核碎裂导致的细胞核肥大。
text_en: Healthy fish had no pathological changes, while fish infected with Ca HV showed necrotic lesions in the head kidney, severe vacuolization, and nuclear hypertrophy caused by karyorrhexis.

quote: s, including IFNγ , IFNphi2 , IFI35 , IFI44-like , IFI56 , IFI58 , Mx1 , Mx3 , MxE , viperin , Gig1 , Gig2 and GBP1 , were up-regulated in all three clones (Additional file 9 : Table S6), indicating that IFN-mediated innate immune response is one of major common immune defenses of gibel carp to Ca HV.
statement: 包括IFNγ、viperin和Gig1在内的多种干扰素系统基因在三个克隆中均上调，表明IFN介导的先天免疫反应是银鲫对CaHV的主要共同免疫防御机制之一。
text_zh: 包括IFNγ、viperin和Gig1在内的多种干扰素系统基因在三个克隆中均上调，表明IFN介导的先天免疫反应是银鲫对CaHV的主要共同免疫防御机制之一。
text_en: Multiple interferon system genes, including IFNγ, viperin, and Gig1, were upregulated in all three clones, indicating that the IFN-mediated innate immune response is one of the main common immune defense mechanisms of gibel carp against CaHV.

quote: The similar dynamical expression changes of IFN system genes were also observed between resistant and susceptible Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) families challenged with infectious pancreatic necrosis virus (IPNV) [ 90 , 91 ].
statement: 在感染传染性胰脏坏死病毒(IPNV)的抗病和易感大西洋鲑家系之间也观察到了类似的干扰素系统基因动态表达变化。
text_zh: 在感染传染性胰脏坏死病毒(IPNV)的抗病和易感大西洋鲑家系之间也观察到了类似的干扰素系统基因动态表达变化。
text_en: Similar dynamic expression changes in interferon system genes were also observed between resistant and susceptible Atlantic salmon families infected with infectious pancreatic necrosis virus (IPNV).

quote: Five tanks of each clone were performed infection with 500 μL Ca HV viral suspension (2.915 × 10 8 virus particles) per fish by intraperitoneal injection.
statement: 每个克隆的五个水箱通过腹腔注射对每条鱼接种500微升鲤疱疹病毒悬浮液（2.915 × 10^8 病毒颗粒）进行感染。
text_zh: 每个克隆的五个水箱通过腹腔注射对每条鱼接种500微升鲤疱疹病毒悬浮液（2.915 × 10^8 病毒颗粒）进行感染。
text_en: Each clone's five tanks were infected by intraperitoneal injection of each fish with 500 microliters of carp herpesvirus suspension (2.915 × 10^8 virus particles).

quote: After infection, fish were put back and grown at 24(±1)°C.
statement: 感染后，鱼被放回并在24(±1)°C条件下养殖。
text_zh: 感染后，鱼被放回并在24(±1)°C条件下养殖。
text_en: After infection, the fish were returned and reared at 24(±1)°C.

quote: Water was filtered consecutively and changed daily to keep it visibly clean.
statement: 水经过连续过滤并每天更换以保持肉眼可见的清洁。
text_zh: 水经过连续过滤并每天更换以保持肉眼可见的清洁。
text_en: The water was continuously filtered and changed daily to maintain visible cleanliness.

quote: Dead fish were taken out timely.
statement: 死鱼被及时取出。
text_zh: 死鱼被及时取出。
text_en: Dead fish were removed in a timely manner.

quote: Apparently healthy individuals were selected to gradually acclimatize in 150-l tanks with aerated water at 24(±1)°C for 2 weeks before infection and fed with commercial feed twice a day.
statement: 在感染前，选择表观健康的个体在充气的150升水箱中于24(±1)°C条件下逐渐适应两周，并每天两次投喂商业饲料。
text_zh: 在感染前，选择表观健康的个体在充气的150升水箱中于24(±1)°C条件下逐渐适应两周，并每天两次投喂商业饲料。
text_en: Before infection, apparently healthy individuals were selected and gradually acclimated for two weeks in aerated 150-liter tanks at 24(±1)°C, and fed commercial feed twice daily.

quote: Before infection, 5 individuals of each clone were randomly selected to perform PCR analysis as previously described [ 74 ] to confirm Ca HV free.
statement: 在感染前，从每个克隆中随机选取5个个体进行PCR分析以确认无鲤疱疹病毒（Ca HV）。
text_zh: 在感染前，从每个克隆中随机选取5个个体进行PCR分析以确认无鲤疱疹病毒（Ca HV）。
text_en: Before infection, 5 individuals were randomly selected from each clone for PCR analysis to confirm the absence of carp herpesvirus (Ca HV).

quote: Individuals of each clone were randomly divided into six tanks with 30 fishes per tank.
statement: 每个克隆的个体被随机分配到六个水箱中，每箱30条鱼。
text_zh: 每个克隆的个体被随机分配到六个水箱中，每箱30条鱼。
text_en: Each cloned individual was randomly assigned to six tanks, with 30 fish per tank.

quote: In addition, the expression levels of factor B and C3 were remarkably lower in the resistant group than in susceptible group of Japanese flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) vaccinated with Streptococcus iniae [ 124 ].
statement: 此外，接种海豚链球菌的牙鲆（Paralichthys olivaceus）中，抗性组的B因子和C3表达水平显著低于易感组。
text_zh: 此外，接种海豚链球菌的牙鲆（Paralichthys olivaceus）中，抗性组的B因子和C3表达水平显著低于易感组。
text_en: In addition, in olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) vaccinated with Streptococcus iniae, the expression levels of Factor B and C3 in the resistant group were significantly lower than those in the susceptible group.

quote: compared with the control group, dietary supplementation with different doses of Trp significantly altered the VH and CD (p −1 Trp, while there was no difference in the ratio of VH to CD (Table 1).
statement: 与对照组相比，日粮补充不同剂量的色氨酸显著改变了绒毛高度（VH）和隐窝深度（CD），但VH与CD的比值没有差异。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，日粮补充不同剂量的色氨酸显著改变了绒毛高度（VH）和隐窝深度（CD），但VH与CD的比值没有差异。
text_en: Compared with the control group, dietary supplementation of different doses of tryptophan significantly changed villus height (VH) and crypt depth (CD), but there was no difference in the VH to CD ratio.

quote: The unweighted UniFrac distance-based PcoA results showed that the microbiota compositions of the control group and the 6.35 Trp group were overt changes.
statement: 基于非加权UniFrac距离的主坐标分析结果显示，对照组和6.35 Trp组的微生物群落组成发生了明显变化。
text_zh: 基于非加权UniFrac距离的主坐标分析结果显示，对照组和6.35 Trp组的微生物群落组成发生了明显变化。
text_en: Principal coordinates analysis based on unweighted UniFrac distance showed that the microbial community composition changed significantly in the control group and the 6.35 Trp group.

quote: Appropriate feeding of Trp has positive effects on the growth performance and intestinal health status of fish by regulating intestinal immune tolerance, maintaining microbial homeostasis, and inhibiting inflammation
statement: 适量饲喂色氨酸通过调节肠道免疫耐受、维持微生物稳态和抑制炎症，对鱼类的生长性能和肠道健康状况有积极影响。
text_zh: 适量饲喂色氨酸通过调节肠道免疫耐受、维持微生物稳态和抑制炎症，对鱼类的生长性能和肠道健康状况有积极影响。
text_en: Appropriate dietary tryptophan supplementation has positive effects on the growth performance and intestinal health of fish by regulating intestinal immune tolerance, maintaining microbial homeostasis, and inhibiting inflammation.

quote: there is growing evidence that Trp deficiency could cause negative impacts on growth performance in fish
statement: 越来越多的证据表明，色氨酸缺乏可能对鱼类的生长性能产生负面影响。
text_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，色氨酸缺乏可能对鱼类的生长性能产生负面影响。
text_en: Increasing evidence suggests that tryptophan deficiency may negatively affect the growth performance of fish.

quote: fish growth performance and the structural integrity of the intestines were altered in a Trp deficient scenario, which translated into lower disease resistance
statement: 在色氨酸缺乏的情况下，鱼类的生长性能和肠道结构完整性发生改变，导致疾病抵抗力降低。
text_zh: 在色氨酸缺乏的情况下，鱼类的生长性能和肠道结构完整性发生改变，导致疾病抵抗力降低。
text_en: In the case of tryptophan deficiency, fish growth performance and intestinal structural integrity are altered, leading to reduced disease resistance.
outcome: 疾病抵抗力与肠道结构

quote: Trp deficiency causes depressed growth and efficiency of feed conversion and low protein retention, as reported for other fish species
statement: 据其他鱼类物种报道，色氨酸缺乏会导致生长迟缓、饲料转化效率低和蛋白质保留率低。
text_zh: 据其他鱼类物种报道，色氨酸缺乏会导致生长迟缓、饲料转化效率低和蛋白质保留率低。
text_en: According to reports on other fish species, tryptophan deficiency leads to stunted growth, low feed conversion efficiency and low protein retention.

quote: A total of 450 healthy ITCC and weight-matched ITCC (23) were randomly divided into five groups, with three biological replicates of each group, and 30 fishes per biological replicate.
statement: 450只健康的ITCC和体重匹配的ITCC被随机分为五组，每组有三个生物学重复，每个重复30条鱼。
text_zh: 450只健康的ITCC和体重匹配的ITCC被随机分为五组，每组有三个生物学重复，每个重复30条鱼。
text_en: 450 healthy ITCC and weight-matched ITCC were randomly divided into five groups, with three biological replicates per group and 30 fish per replicate.

quote: The Trp concentrations in the five experimental diets were determined to be 1.85 (control), 3.35, 4.85, 6.35, and 7.85 g kg −1 Trp diet (basal diets supplemented with 0, 1.5, 3.0, 4.5, and 6.0 g kg −1 Trp).
statement: 五种实验日粮中的色氨酸浓度分别为1.85（对照）、3.35、4.85、6.35和7.85 g/kg（基础日粮分别补充0、1.5、3.0、4.5和6.0 g/kg色氨酸）。
text_zh: 五种实验日粮中的色氨酸浓度分别为1.85（对照）、3.35、4.85、6.35和7.85 g/kg（基础日粮分别补充0、1.5、3.0、4.5和6.0 g/kg色氨酸）。
text_en: The tryptophan concentrations in the five experimental diets were 1.85 (control), 3.35, 4.85, 6.35 and 7.85 g/kg (the basal diet was supplemented with 0, 1.5, 3.0, 4.5 and 6.0 g/kg tryptophan, respectively).

quote: At the end of the feeding trial, all the experimental fish fasted for 12 h.
statement: 在饲喂试验结束时，所有实验鱼禁食12小时。
text_zh: 在饲喂试验结束时，所有实验鱼禁食12小时。
text_en: At the end of the feeding trial, all experimental fish were fasted for 12 hours.

quote: Three fish from each replicate (a total of 45 fish) were randomly selected, anesthetized, sacrificed, and sampled according to the method described in a previous study (24).
statement: 从每个重复中随机选取三条鱼（共45条），按照先前研究描述的方法进行麻醉、处死和取样。
text_zh: 从每个重复中随机选取三条鱼（共45条），按照先前研究描述的方法进行麻醉、处死和取样。
text_en: Three fish were randomly selected from each replicate (45 in total) and anesthetized, euthanized, and sampled according to the methods described in previous studies.

quote: improved triploid crucian carp (ITCC) fed diets containing 6.35 g kg −1 Trp had higher average daily gain (ADG) and improved villus height (VH) and crypt depth (CD) in the intestine compared to the control group.
statement: 饲喂含6.35 g/kg色氨酸日粮的异育银鲫比对照组具有更高的平均日增重，且肠道绒毛高度和隐窝深度得到改善。
text_zh: 饲喂含6.35 g/kg色氨酸日粮的异育银鲫比对照组具有更高的平均日增重，且肠道绒毛高度和隐窝深度得到改善。
text_en: Allogynetic gibel carp fed a diet containing 6.35 g/kg tryptophan had higher average daily gain than the control group, and intestinal villus height and crypt depth were improved.

population.species: 异育银鲫 (improved triploid crucian carp)

quote: Indian major carp (Labeo rohita) recombinant IL10 protein induced down-regulation of most pro-inflammatory cytokines and up-regulation of natural killer enhancing factors [ 111 ].
statement: 印度主要鲤鱼（Labeo rohita）重组IL10蛋白诱导大多数促炎细胞因子下调以及自然杀伤增强因子上调。
text_zh: 印度主要鲤鱼（Labeo rohita）重组IL10蛋白诱导大多数促炎细胞因子下调以及自然杀伤增强因子上调。
text_en: Recombinant IL10 protein in Indian major carp (Labeo rohita) induced downregulation of most pro-inflammatory cytokines and upregulation of natural killer enhancement factor.

quote: However, information regarding the effects of amino acids on the growth performance and intestinal health status of ITCC is lacking.
statement: 然而，关于氨基酸对ITCC生长性能和肠道健康状况影响的信息尚缺乏。
text_zh: 然而，关于氨基酸对ITCC生长性能和肠道健康状况影响的信息尚缺乏。
text_en: However, information on the effects of amino acids on the growth performance and gut health of ITCC is still lacking.

quote: Moreover, little information has been done on the effect of Trp on the growth performance and intestinal health of ITCC.
statement: 此外，关于色氨酸（Trp）对ITCC生长性能和肠道健康影响的研究很少。
text_zh: 此外，关于色氨酸（Trp）对ITCC生长性能和肠道健康影响的研究很少。
text_en: In addition, there is little research on the effects of tryptophan (Trp) on the growth performance and gut health of ITCC.

quote: This study will provide guidance for developing effective nutritional strategies and feeding practices to improve ITCC health.
statement: 本研究将为制定有效的营养策略和饲养实践以改善ITCC健康提供指导。
text_zh: 本研究将为制定有效的营养策略和饲养实践以改善ITCC健康提供指导。
text_en: This study will provide guidance for developing effective nutritional strategies and feeding practices to improve ITCC health.

quote: Trp improved hybrid catfish growth performance, digestive, and absorptive abilities (34).
statement: 色氨酸改善了杂交鲶鱼的生长性能、消化和吸收能力。
text_zh: 色氨酸改善了杂交鲶鱼的生长性能、消化和吸收能力。
text_en: Tryptophan improved the growth performance, digestion and absorption capacity of hybrid catfish.
outcome: 生长性能; 消化吸收能力

quote: In this study, we found that the growth performance of ITCC increased as the dietary Trp levels increased (up to 6.35 g kg −1).
statement: 本研究发现，随着膳食色氨酸水平的增加（最高至6.35 g kg−1），ITCC的生长性能提高。
text_zh: 本研究发现，随着膳食色氨酸水平的增加（最高至6.35 g kg−1），ITCC的生长性能提高。
text_en: This study found that the growth performance of ITCC improved with increasing dietary tryptophan levels (up to 6.35 g kg−1).

quote: This result supports that optimal dietary Trp could improve the growth performance and feed efficiency as reported in juvenile Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var. Jian) (13), silver catfish (33), red drum (14), Indian catfish (Ahmed et al., 2012), and Nile tilapia (35).
statement: 这一结果支持了最佳膳食色氨酸可以改善生长性能和饲料效率的观点，这在建鲤、银鲶、红鼓鱼、印度鲶和尼罗罗非鱼中已有报道。
text_zh: 这一结果支持了最佳膳食色氨酸可以改善生长性能和饲料效率的观点，这在建鲤、银鲶、红鼓鱼、印度鲶和尼罗罗非鱼中已有报道。
text_en: This result supports the view that optimal dietary tryptophan can improve growth performance and feed efficiency, which has been reported in Jian carp, silver catfish, red drum, Indian catfish, and Nile tilapia.

population.species: 建鲤; 银鲶; 红鼓鱼; 印度鲶; 尼罗罗非鱼

outcome: 生长性能; 饲料效率

quote: Dietary supplementation of l-tryptophan mitigates crowding stress and augments the growth in Cirrhinus mrigala fingerlings.
statement: 日粮补充L-色氨酸可缓解米氏鲮鱼种的拥挤应激并促进其生长。
text_zh: 日粮补充L-色氨酸可缓解米氏鲮鱼种的拥挤应激并促进其生长。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with L-tryptophan can alleviate crowding stress and promote growth in Oreochromis mossambicus fingerlings.

quote: How tryptophan levels in plant-based aquafeeds affect fish physiology, metabolism and proteome.
statement: 植物性水产饲料中的色氨酸水平影响鱼类的生理、代谢和蛋白质组。
text_zh: 植物性水产饲料中的色氨酸水平影响鱼类的生理、代谢和蛋白质组。
text_en: Tryptophan levels in plant-based aquatic feed affect the physiology, metabolism, and proteome of fish.
intervention_record: 植物性饲料色氨酸水平

quote: However, more studies are needed to clarify the interaction between host gene expression and gut microbiota in ITCC fed a diet with 6.35 g kg −1 Trp.
statement: 然而，需要更多的研究来阐明饲喂含6.35 g/kg色氨酸日粮的ITCC中宿主基因表达与肠道微生物群之间的相互作用。
text_zh: 然而，需要更多的研究来阐明饲喂含6.35 g/kg色氨酸日粮的ITCC中宿主基因表达与肠道微生物群之间的相互作用。
text_en: However, more research is needed to elucidate the interaction between host gene expression and gut microbiota in ITCC fed a diet containing 6.35 g/kg tryptophan.
limitations: 现有研究未能完全阐明宿主基因表达与肠道微生物群的相互作用

quote: After deep anesthesia using MS-222 (200 mg/L), the intestine samples were taken from fish
statement: 在采集肠道样本前，使用MS-222（200 mg/L）对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 在采集肠道样本前，使用MS-222（200 mg/L）对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Before collecting intestinal samples, fish were deeply anesthetized using MS-222 (200 mg/L).

quote: The crucian carp were randomly selected and dissected for histopathological examination.
statement: 随机选择鲫鱼并进行解剖以进行组织病理学检查。
text_zh: 随机选择鲫鱼并进行解剖以进行组织病理学检查。
text_en: Crucian carp were randomly selected and dissected for histopathological examination.

quote: The changes in gut microbiota influence the occurrence and development of diseases such as bacterial enteritis (3 – 5).
statement: 肠道微生物群的变化会影响细菌性肠炎等疾病的发生和发展。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群的变化会影响细菌性肠炎等疾病的发生和发展。
text_en: Changes in the gut microbiota affect the occurrence and development of diseases such as bacterial enteritis.

quote: Several DEMs (e.g., miR-129, miR-203, and miR-205) play crucial roles in the intestinal mucosal immune response in C. auratus to R. aquatilis infection.
statement: 几种差异表达miRNA（如miR-129、miR-203和miR-205）在鲤鲫对水氏拉恩氏菌感染的肠黏膜免疫反应中起关键作用。
text_zh: 几种差异表达miRNA（如miR-129、miR-203和miR-205）在鲤鲫对水氏拉恩氏菌感染的肠黏膜免疫反应中起关键作用。
text_en: Several differentially expressed miRNAs (such as miR-129, miR-203 and miR-205) play a key role in the intestinal mucosal immune response of carp crucian to Rahnella wateri infection.

quote: Infection by an emerging bacterial pathogen Rahnella aquatilis caused enteritis and septicemia in fish.
statement: 水氏拉恩菌感染导致鱼类发生肠炎和败血症。
text_zh: 水氏拉恩菌感染导致鱼类发生肠炎和败血症。
text_en: Infection with Rahnella aquatilis causes enteritis and septicemia in fish.

quote: C. auratus intraperitoneally injected with R. aquatilis KCL-5 was used as an experimental animal model, and the intestinal pathological changes, microflora, and differentially expressed miRNAs (DEMs) were investigated by multi-omics analysis.
statement: 通过腹腔注射R. aquatilis KCL-5建立鲫鱼实验动物模型，并利用多组学分析研究肠道病理变化、菌群及差异表达miRNA。
text_zh: 通过腹腔注射R. aquatilis KCL-5建立鲫鱼实验动物模型，并利用多组学分析研究肠道病理变化、菌群及差异表达miRNA。
text_en: An experimental animal model of crucian carp was established by intraperitoneal injection of R. aquatilis KCL-5, and multi-omics analysis was used to study intestinal pathological changes, microbiota, and differentially expressed miRNAs.
outcome: 实验模型构建与病理监测

quote: The significant changes in histopathological features, apoptotic cells, and enzyme activities (e.g., lysozyme (LYS), alkaline phosphatase (AKP), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST), and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px)) in the intestine were examined after infection.
statement: 感染后观察到肠道组织病理特征、凋亡细胞以及多种酶活性（如溶菌酶、碱性磷酸酶等）的显著变化。
text_zh: 感染后观察到肠道组织病理特征、凋亡细胞以及多种酶活性（如溶菌酶、碱性磷酸酶等）的显著变化。
text_en: Significant changes in intestinal histopathological features, apoptotic cells, and the activity of multiple enzymes (such as lysozyme, alkaline phosphatase, etc.) were observed after infection.

quote: Deficiency in dietary Trp could alter the gut microbial community (61).
statement: 日粮中色氨酸缺乏可能会改变肠道微生物群落。
text_zh: 日粮中色氨酸缺乏可能会改变肠道微生物群落。
text_en: Tryptophan deficiency in the diet may alter the gut microbial community.

quote: It is worth noting that Trp increased the richness and diversity of the intestinal microbiota, perhaps partly because Trp promoted the growth of the intestinal villi, thus increasing the nutrients available to the intestinal flora (34 , 62 , 67).
statement: 值得注意的是，色氨酸增加了肠道微生物群的丰富度和多样性，这可能部分是因为色氨酸促进了肠绒毛的生长，从而增加了肠道菌群可利用的营养物质。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，色氨酸增加了肠道微生物群的丰富度和多样性，这可能部分是因为色氨酸促进了肠绒毛的生长，从而增加了肠道菌群可利用的营养物质。
text_en: It is worth noting that tryptophan increased the richness and diversity of the gut microbiota, which may be partly because tryptophan promoted the growth of intestinal villi, thereby increasing the nutrients available to the gut microbiota.
outcome: 肠道微生物群丰富度与多样性

quote: Numerous studies have confirmed the effect of Cetobacterium on the digestion and absorption of food, and the general growth and development process of fishes (Yunlong Grouper, common carp, and tilapia) (73 , 74).
statement: 大量研究证实了鲸杆菌属对鱼类食物消化吸收以及一般生长发育过程的影响。
text_zh: 大量研究证实了鲸杆菌属对鱼类食物消化吸收以及一般生长发育过程的影响。
text_en: Numerous studies have confirmed the impact of Cetobacterium on food digestion and absorption as well as general growth and development processes in fish.

population.species: Yunlong Grouper, common carp, and tilapia

quote: In the present study, the abundance of Cetobacterium was increased significantly by 6.35 g kg −1 Trp treatment in ITCC, suggesting that Cetobacterium might play a cru
statement: 在本研究中，ITCC中6.35 g/kg色氨酸处理显著增加了鲸杆菌属的丰度，表明鲸杆菌属可能起关键作用。
text_zh: 在本研究中，ITCC中6.35 g/kg色氨酸处理显著增加了鲸杆菌属的丰度，表明鲸杆菌属可能起关键作用。
text_en: In this study, the 6.35 g/kg tryptophan treatment in ITCC significantly increased the abundance of Cetobacterium, indicating that Cetobacterium may play a key role.

quote: The crucian carp infected with R. aquatilis strain KCL-5 caused symptoms of enteritis and septicemia.
statement: 感染R. aquatilis菌株KCL-5的鲫鱼表现出肠炎和败血症的症状。
text_zh: 感染R. aquatilis菌株KCL-5的鲫鱼表现出肠炎和败血症的症状。
text_en: Crucian carp infected with R. aquatilis strain KCL-5 showed symptoms of enteritis and septicemia.

quote: Histopathological observation showed necrosis, degeneration and exfoliation of intestinal mucosal epithelial cells, severe injury and shortening of intestinal villi, bleeding of the submucosa, mucosal layer and muscular layer thinning, intestinal hemorrhage, necrosis, and vacuolation (Figure 1A); intestinal mucous cells increased and stained blue after AB-PAS staining, distributed with goblet cells (Figure 1B).
statement: 组织病理学观察显示肠黏膜上皮细胞坏死、变性和脱落，肠绒毛严重损伤和缩短，黏膜下层出血，黏膜层和肌层变薄，肠道出血、坏死和空泡化；AB-PAS染色后肠黏液细胞增加并染成蓝色，与杯状细胞分布在一起。
text_zh: 组织病理学观察显示肠黏膜上皮细胞坏死、变性和脱落，肠绒毛严重损伤和缩短，黏膜下层出血，黏膜层和肌层变薄，肠道出血、坏死和空泡化；AB-PAS染色后肠黏液细胞增加并染成蓝色，与杯状细胞分布在一起。
text_en: Histopathological observation showed necrosis, degeneration and shedding of intestinal mucosal epithelial cells, severe damage and shortening of intestinal villi, hemorrhage in the submucosa, thinning of the mucosa and muscularis layers, intestinal hemorrhage, necrosis and vacuolation; after AB-PAS staining, intestinal mucus cells increased and stained blue, distributed together with goblet cells.

quote: All the crucian carp (average weight 250 ± 10 g, average length 21 ± 1 cm) used in this experiment were purchased from Tianjin Aquatic Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd. (Tianjin, China) and acclimatized at a temperature of approximately 24°C ± 0.5°C in freshwater tanks.
statement: 实验使用的鲫鱼在约24°C的淡水缸中进行了驯化。
text_zh: 实验使用的鲫鱼在约24°C的淡水缸中进行了驯化。
text_en: The crucian carp used in the experiment were acclimated in freshwater tanks at about 24°C.

quote: In the infection experiment, the fish were intraperitoneally injected with R. aquatilis with a final concentration of 6 × 10 8 CFU/mL based on the concentration of 50% lethal dose (LD 50) by our group report (30).
statement: 鱼被腹腔注射浓度为6×10^8 CFU/mL的水生拉氏菌，该剂量基于半数致死量(LD50)。
text_zh: 鱼被腹腔注射浓度为6×10^8 CFU/mL的水生拉氏菌，该剂量基于半数致死量(LD50)。
text_en: Fish were intraperitoneally injected with Edwardsiella ictaluri at a concentration of 6×10^8 CFU/mL, a dose based on the median lethal dose (LD50).
outcome: 疾病诱导与死亡率风险

quote: The fish were randomly selected, and the intestines were sampled at 0, 36, and 72 h post-infection (hpi), according to the clinical signs and our laboratory findings (30 , 32), such as skin bleeding, ascites, and enteritis; the pathological changes were observed during early infection.
statement: 根据皮肤出血、腹水和肠炎等临床症状及实验室发现，在感染后0、36和72小时采集肠道样本以观察早期感染的病理变化。
text_zh: 根据皮肤出血、腹水和肠炎等临床症状及实验室发现，在感染后0、36和72小时采集肠道样本以观察早期感染的病理变化。
text_en: Based on clinical symptoms such as skin hemorrhage, ascites, and enteritis, as well as laboratory findings, intestinal samples were collected at 0, 36, and 72 hours post-infection to observe the pathological changes of early infection.

quote: Optimal Trp exerts beneficial effects on maintaining the intestinal structural integrity and intestinal development of fish (13 , 48).
statement: 最佳水平的色氨酸对维持鱼类的肠道结构完整性和肠道发育产生有益影响。
text_zh: 最佳水平的色氨酸对维持鱼类的肠道结构完整性和肠道发育产生有益影响。
text_en: Optimal levels of tryptophan have beneficial effects on maintaining intestinal structural integrity and intestinal development in fish.

quote: In this study, feeding 6.35 g kg −1 Trp diets significantly increased villus height and crypt depth, which suggests that dietary Trp can influence the morphological structure of the intestine, which might be associated with nutrient digestion and absorption.
statement: 在本研究中，喂食含6.35 g/kg色氨酸的日粮显著增加了绒毛高度和隐窝深度，这表明膳食色氨酸可以影响肠道的形态结构，这可能与营养物质的消化和吸收有关。
text_zh: 在本研究中，喂食含6.35 g/kg色氨酸的日粮显著增加了绒毛高度和隐窝深度，这表明膳食色氨酸可以影响肠道的形态结构，这可能与营养物质的消化和吸收有关。
text_en: In this study, feeding a diet containing 6.35 g/kg tryptophan significantly increased villus height and crypt depth, indicating that dietary tryptophan can affect the morphological structure of the intestine, which may be related to the digestion and absorption of nutrients.

quote: Similar results showed that Trp improves the digestive and absorption capacity of fish (34 , 49).
statement: 类似的结果表明，色氨酸改善了鱼类的消化和吸收能力。
text_zh: 类似的结果表明，色氨酸改善了鱼类的消化和吸收能力。
text_en: Similar results indicate that tryptophan improved the digestion and absorption capacity of fish.

quote: According to the Venn diagram (Figure 3A), the number of public OTUs was 634, of which the unique number of OTUs at 0 and 36 hpi was 1, while the unique number of OTUs at 72 hpi was 12, indicating that there were some important differences in OTUs among groups after R. aquatilis was injected into crucian carp at different infection time.
statement: Rahnella aquatilis注射后，不同感染时间点的鲫鱼肠道菌群OTU组成存在重要差异。
text_zh: Rahnella aquatilis注射后，不同感染时间点的鲫鱼肠道菌群OTU组成存在重要差异。
text_en: After Rahnella aquatilis injection, there were significant differences in the gut microbiota OTU composition of crucian carp at different infection time points.

quote: The relative abundance of Proteobacteria decreased significantly at 36 hpi after infection, while that of Fusobacteria increased significantly
statement: 感染后36小时，变形菌门相对丰度显著下降，而梭杆菌门相对丰度显著上升。
text_zh: 感染后36小时，变形菌门相对丰度显著下降，而梭杆菌门相对丰度显著上升。
text_en: At 36 hours post-infection, the relative abundance of Proteobacteria significantly decreased, while the relative abundance of Fusobacteriota significantly increased.

quote: The relative abundance of the Cetobacterium increased significantly at 36 hpi.
statement: 感染后36小时，鲸杆菌属的相对丰度显著增加。
text_zh: 感染后36小时，鲸杆菌属的相对丰度显著增加。
text_en: At 36 hours post-infection, the relative abundance of Cetobacterium significantly increased.

quote: In contrast, the relative abundance of Escherichia – Shigella decreased continuously and especially decreased significantly at 72 hpi
statement: 相比之下，大肠杆菌-志贺氏菌属的相对丰度持续下降，并在感染后72小时显著降低。
text_zh: 相比之下，大肠杆菌-志贺氏菌属的相对丰度持续下降，并在感染后72小时显著降低。
text_en: In contrast, the relative abundance of Escherichia coli-Shigella genus continuously decreased and was significantly reduced at 72 hours post-infection.

quote: In recent years, crucian carp were infected with bacteria and caused diseases more frequently due to the high-density culture (27 , 30 – 32).
statement: 近年来，由于高密度养殖，鲫鱼更频繁地感染细菌并引发疾病。
text_zh: 近年来，由于高密度养殖，鲫鱼更频繁地感染细菌并引发疾病。
text_en: In recent years, due to high-density culture, crucian carp have been more frequently infected by bacteria and developed diseases.

quote: R. aquatilis has been recognized as an emerging bacterial pathogen, and more and more infections were detected in fish, which have demonstrated that R. aquatilis caused clinical enteritis and septicemia
statement: 水栖拉氏菌被确认为一种新兴细菌病原体，在鱼类中检测到的感染越来越多，并证实该菌引起临床肠炎和败血症。
text_zh: 水栖拉氏菌被确认为一种新兴细菌病原体，在鱼类中检测到的感染越来越多，并证实该菌引起临床肠炎和败血症。
text_en: Lactobacillus aquaticus has been identified as an emerging bacterial pathogen, with increasing detection of infections in fish, and it has been confirmed to cause clinical enteritis and septicemia.

quote: Bacterial diseases, especially bacterial enteritis, are a major problem in crucian carp Carassius auratus , which has caused large economic losses
statement: 细菌性疾病，特别是细菌性肠炎，是鲫鱼的一个主要问题，已造成巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 细菌性疾病，特别是细菌性肠炎，是鲫鱼的一个主要问题，已造成巨大的经济损失。
text_en: Bacterial diseases, especially bacterial enteritis, are a major problem for crucian carp and have caused huge economic losses.

quote: Compared with that at 0 hpi, the Chao1 index of the microflora increased significantly at 72 hpi (p = 0.019), indicating that the species richness of the intestinal microflora increased after 72 hpi
statement: 与0小时感染后相比，72小时感染后的微生物群Chao1指数显著增加，表明肠道微生物群的物种丰富度在72小时后增加。
text_zh: 与0小时感染后相比，72小时感染后的微生物群Chao1指数显著增加，表明肠道微生物群的物种丰富度在72小时后增加。
text_en: Compared to 0 hours post-infection, the microbial Chao1 index at 72 hours post-infection increased significantly, indicating that gut microbiota species richness increased after 72 hours.
outcome: 肠道微生物群物种丰富度

quote: but the ACE, Shannon, and Simpson indexes of the microflora did not significantly change (ACE, p = 0.064; Shannon, p = 0.25; Simpson, p = 0.19)
statement: 但微生物群的ACE、Shannon和Simpson指数没有显著变化。
text_zh: 但微生物群的ACE、Shannon和Simpson指数没有显著变化。
text_en: However, there were no significant changes in the ACE, Shannon, and Simpson indices of the microbiota.
outcome: 肠道微生物群多样性指数（ACE, Shannon, Simpson）

quote: illustrating that R. aquatilis had an effect on the composition and structure of the intestinal microflora in crucian carp.
statement: 这表明R. aquatilis对鲫鱼肠道微生物群的组成和结构有影响。
text_zh: 这表明R. aquatilis对鲫鱼肠道微生物群的组成和结构有影响。
text_en: This indicates that R. aquatilis affects the composition and structure of the gut microbiota in crucian carp.
outcome: 肠道微生物群组成和结构

quote: A previous study showed that dietary Trp could improve the digestion and absorption ability of juvenile Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var . Jian) (13).
statement: 先前的研究表明，日粮色氨酸可以提高建鲤幼鱼的消化吸收能力。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，日粮色氨酸可以提高建鲤幼鱼的消化吸收能力。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that dietary tryptophan can improve the digestion and absorption capacity of juvenile Jian carp.

population.species: juvenile Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var . Jian)

quote: Thus, the increase in the abundance of Cetobacterium and Fusobacteria might indicate the positive effect of Trp in balancing the gut microbiota, which may be most strongly linked to health performance.
statement: 因此，Cetobacterium和Fusobacteria丰度的增加可能表明色氨酸在平衡肠道菌群方面的积极作用，这可能与健康表现最密切相关。
text_zh: 因此，Cetobacterium和Fusobacteria丰度的增加可能表明色氨酸在平衡肠道菌群方面的积极作用，这可能与健康表现最密切相关。
text_en: Therefore, the increase in the abundance of Cetobacterium and Fusobacteria may indicate a positive role of tryptophan in balancing gut microbiota, which is most closely associated with health performance.
outcome: 肠道菌群平衡与健康表现

quote: Overall, our study suggests that dietary 6.35 g kg −1 Trp had a beneficial effect on gut microbes and regulated the abundance of gut microbes in ITCC.
statement: 总体而言，我们的研究表明，日粮中添加6.35 g kg−1色氨酸对肠道微生物有益，并调节了ITCC中肠道微生物的丰度。
text_zh: 总体而言，我们的研究表明，日粮中添加6.35 g kg−1色氨酸对肠道微生物有益，并调节了ITCC中肠道微生物的丰度。
text_en: Overall, our study shows that dietary supplementation with 6.35 g kg−1 tryptophan is beneficial to gut microbiota and modulates the abundance of gut microbiota in ITCC.

quote: However, further work needs to be done determine the effects of Trp on certain beneficial intestinal bacteria.
statement: 然而，需要进一步的工作来确定色氨酸对某些有益肠道细菌的影响。
text_zh: 然而，需要进一步的工作来确定色氨酸对某些有益肠道细菌的影响。
text_en: However, further work is needed to determine the effect of tryptophan on certain beneficial gut bacteria.
limitations: 需进一步确定色氨酸对特定有益菌的影响

quote: In this study, dietary Trp was found to improve the growth performance and intestinal health of ITCC.
statement: 本研究发现，日粮色氨酸改善了ITCC的生长性能和肠道健康。
text_zh: 本研究发现，日粮色氨酸改善了ITCC的生长性能和肠道健康。
text_en: This study found that dietary tryptophan improved the growth performance and intestinal health of ITCC.

quote: regulation of the microbiota is a feasible strategy to alleviate emerging diseases in teleosts (7).
statement: 调节微生物群是缓解硬骨鱼类新发疾病的可行策略。
text_zh: 调节微生物群是缓解硬骨鱼类新发疾病的可行策略。
text_en: Modulating the microbiota is a feasible strategy for mitigating emerging diseases in teleost fish.

quote: Bacterial pathogens from the intestine can migrate through the epithelial mucosa to infect internal organs and injure the host.
statement: 来自肠道的细菌病原体可以穿过上皮黏膜感染内部器官并伤害宿主。
text_zh: 来自肠道的细菌病原体可以穿过上皮黏膜感染内部器官并伤害宿主。
text_en: Bacterial pathogens from the intestine can cross the epithelial mucosa to infect internal organs and harm the host.

quote: In previous studies, crucian carp infected with pathogenic Salmonella and Vibrio anguillarum were found to have damaged intestinal cells (12).
statement: 在先前的研究中，发现感染致病性沙门氏菌和鳗弧菌的鲫鱼存在肠道细胞受损。
text_zh: 在先前的研究中，发现感染致病性沙门氏菌和鳗弧菌的鲫鱼存在肠道细胞受损。
text_en: In previous studies, intestinal cell damage was found in crucian carp infected with pathogenic Salmonella and Vibrio anguillarum.

quote: In fish, the disturbance of the intestinal microflora can lead to impaired physiological function, such as dysfunction of intestinal epithelial cells and weakening of nutrient absorption, metabolism, and immune response (13).
statement: 在鱼类中，肠道微生态失调会导致生理功能障碍，如肠上皮细胞功能障碍以及营养吸收、代谢和免疫反应减弱。
text_zh: 在鱼类中，肠道微生态失调会导致生理功能障碍，如肠上皮细胞功能障碍以及营养吸收、代谢和免疫反应减弱。
text_en: In fish, intestinal dysbiosis leads to physiological dysfunction, such as intestinal epithelial cell dysfunction and weakened nutrient absorption, metabolism, and immune response.

quote: The activity of LYS decreased by 50% at 36 hpi after infection and then increased by 66.67% at 72 hpi.
statement: 感染后36小时溶菌酶（LYS）活性下降50%，随后在72小时上升66.67%。
text_zh: 感染后36小时溶菌酶（LYS）活性下降50%，随后在72小时上升66.67%。
text_en: Lysozyme (LYS) activity decreased by 50% at 36 hours post-infection, then increased by 66.67% at 72 hours.

quote: In contrast, the activities of AKP, ALT, AST, and GSH-Px increased at first and then decreased.
statement: 相比之下，碱性磷酸酶（AKP）、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）的活性先升高后降低。
text_zh: 相比之下，碱性磷酸酶（AKP）、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）的活性先升高后降低。
text_en: In contrast, the activities of alkaline phosphatase (AKP), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) first increased and then decreased.

quote: Recently, intensive culture of commercial fish such as crucian carp has increased the severity and frequency of diseases in China (27 , 29 – 32).
statement: 最近，中国商业鱼类如鲫鱼的集约化养殖增加了疾病的严重程度和频率。
text_zh: 最近，中国商业鱼类如鲫鱼的集约化养殖增加了疾病的严重程度和频率。
text_en: Recently, the intensive culture of commercial fish in China, such as crucian carp, has increased the severity and frequency of diseases.

quote: The results showed that K-means clustering ultimately divided the data into two categories, with six DEMs such as miR-206, miR-206-3p, and novel-miR-1631 clustered into one category, showing an increasing co-expression trend.
statement: 结果显示，K-means聚类最终将数据分为两类，其中六个差异表达miRNAs（如miR-206等）聚为一类，呈现共表达增加的趋势。
text_zh: 结果显示，K-means聚类最终将数据分为两类，其中六个差异表达miRNAs（如miR-206等）聚为一类，呈现共表达增加的趋势。
text_en: The results showed that K-means clustering ultimately divided the data into two categories, in which six differentially expressed miRNAs (such as miR-206) clustered into one category, exhibiting a trend of increased co-expression.

quote: However, the expression of C3 and LysC decreased significantly at 36 hpi
statement: 然而，C3和LysC的表达在感染后36小时显著下降。
text_zh: 然而，C3和LysC的表达在感染后36小时显著下降。
text_en: However, the expression of C3 and LysC significantly decreased at 36 hours post-infection.

quote: MHC II , NF-κB , and TGF-β were significantly upregulated and then decreased
statement: MHC II、NF-κB和TGF-β显著上调随后下降。
text_zh: MHC II、NF-κB和TGF-β显著上调随后下降。
text_en: MHC II, NF-κB and TGF-β were significantly upregulated and then decreased.
outcome: 免疫信号通路基因表达

quote: Pathological observation results showed that the cell apoptosis was induced by R. aquatilis infection through apoptosis-related genes, such as expression of TAP1 and TNF-α in the kidney
statement: 病理观察结果显示，R. aquatilis感染通过肾脏中TAP1和TNF-α等凋亡相关基因的表达诱导细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 病理观察结果显示，R. aquatilis感染通过肾脏中TAP1和TNF-α等凋亡相关基因的表达诱导细胞凋亡。
text_en: Pathological observation results showed that R. aquatilis infection induced apoptosis through the expression of apoptosis-related genes such as TAP1 and TNF-α in the kidney.

quote: a pathogenic R. aquatilis strain KCL-5 was isolated from the diseased crucian carp, which was recognized as a new aquatic pathogen that causes high lethality in fish
statement: 从患病鲫鱼中分离出的致病性水氏拉恩菌KCL-5菌株被认定为一种导致鱼类高死亡率的新水生病原体。
text_zh: 从患病鲫鱼中分离出的致病性水氏拉恩菌KCL-5菌株被认定为一种导致鱼类高死亡率的新水生病原体。
text_en: The pathogenic Rahnella aquatilis strain KCL-5 isolated from diseased crucian carp was identified as a new aquatic pathogen causing high mortality in fish.

quote: the thickness of the mucosal layer, muscular layer, and intestinal villus length was decreased after bacterial infection
statement: 细菌感染后，黏膜层、肌层的厚度和肠绒毛长度均减少。
text_zh: 细菌感染后，黏膜层、肌层的厚度和肠绒毛长度均减少。
text_en: After bacterial infection, the thickness of the mucosal layer and muscle layer, as well as the intestinal villus length, all decreased.

quote: In this study, AKP was significantly increased after infection with R. aquatilis , indicating that it plays a crucial role in regulating the host immune response to bacterial infection (50).
statement: 本研究中，感染R. aquatilis后AKP显著升高，表明其在调节宿主对细菌感染的免疫反应中起关键作用。
text_zh: 本研究中，感染R. aquatilis后AKP显著升高，表明其在调节宿主对细菌感染的免疫反应中起关键作用。
text_en: In this study, AKP significantly increased after R. aquatilis infection, indicating its key role in regulating the host immune response to bacterial infection.

quote: Inhibition of Aeromonas hydrophila -induced intestinal inflammation and mucosal barrier function damage in crucian carp by oral administration of Lactococcus lactis
statement: 口服乳酸乳球菌可抑制鲤鲫鱼中由嗜水气单胞菌引起的肠道炎症和黏膜屏障功能损伤。
text_zh: 口服乳酸乳球菌可抑制鲤鲫鱼中由嗜水气单胞菌引起的肠道炎症和黏膜屏障功能损伤。
text_en: Oral administration of Lactococcus lactis can inhibit intestinal inflammation and mucosal barrier dysfunction caused by Aeromonas hydrophila in common carp and crucian carp.

quote: In addition, the short-chain fatty acids may be produced by Firmicutes and Proteobacteria in the intestinal microflora, thereby inhibiting or promoting inflammatory factors TNF-α and TGF-β to regulate intestinal inflammation.
statement: 厚壁菌门和变形菌门产生的短链脂肪酸可能通过抑制或促进炎症因子TNF-α和TGF-β来调节肠道炎症。
text_zh: 厚壁菌门和变形菌门产生的短链脂肪酸可能通过抑制或促进炎症因子TNF-α和TGF-β来调节肠道炎症。
text_en: Short-chain fatty acids produced by Firmicutes and Proteobacteria may regulate intestinal inflammation by inhibiting or promoting the inflammatory factors TNF-α and TGF-β.

quote: MiRNA and the intestinal microflora may interact with the immune-related genes to play an important role in the mucosal immune response of crucian carp infected with R. aquatilis .
statement: miRNA和肠道菌群可能与免疫相关基因相互作用，在感染Aeromonas salmonicida（注：原文为R. aquatilis）的鲫鱼黏膜免疫反应中发挥重要作用。
text_zh: miRNA和肠道菌群可能与免疫相关基因相互作用，在感染Aeromonas salmonicida（注：原文为R. aquatilis）的鲫鱼黏膜免疫反应中发挥重要作用。
text_en: miRNA and gut microbiota may interact with immune-related genes, playing an important role in the mucosal immune response of crucian carp infected with Aeromonas salmonicida (note: original text was R. aquatilis).

quote: Influences of chronic copper exposure on intestinal histology, antioxidative and immune status, and transcriptomic response in freshwater grouper (Acrossocheilus fasciatus).
statement: 慢性铜暴露影响淡水石斑鱼（Acrossocheilus fasciatus）的肠道组织学、抗氧化和免疫状态以及转录组反应。
text_zh: 慢性铜暴露影响淡水石斑鱼（Acrossocheilus fasciatus）的肠道组织学、抗氧化和免疫状态以及转录组反应。
text_en: Chronic copper exposure affects the intestinal histology, antioxidant and immune status, and transcriptomic responses of freshwater barbel chub (Acrossocheilus fasciatus).

quote: Antibiotic growth promoter olaquindox increases pathogen susceptibility in fish by inducing gut microbiota dysbiosis.
statement: 抗生素生长促进剂喹乙醇通过诱导鱼类肠道菌群失调来增加其对病原体的易感性。
text_zh: 抗生素生长促进剂喹乙醇通过诱导鱼类肠道菌群失调来增加其对病原体的易感性。
text_en: The antibiotic growth promoter quinolone increases fish susceptibility to pathogens by inducing intestinal microbiota dysbiosis.
outcome: 疾病易感性与肠道菌群平衡

quote: Spearman’s correlation analysis was used to explore the potential relationship between the key DEMs of intestinal mucosal immunity and the intestinal microflora in the crucian carp intestine infected with R. aquatilis .
statement: 使用Spearman相关分析探索感染R. aquatilis的鲫鱼肠道中肠黏膜免疫关键差异表达分子与肠道菌群之间的潜在关系。
text_zh: 使用Spearman相关分析探索感染R. aquatilis的鲫鱼肠道中肠黏膜免疫关键差异表达分子与肠道菌群之间的潜在关系。
text_en: Spearman correlation analysis was used to explore the potential relationship between key differentially expressed molecules of intestinal mucosal immunity and gut microbiota in the intestines of crucian carp infected with R. aquatilis.

quote: It is suggested that miRNA may cooperate with the intestinal microflora to regulate intestinal inflammation and immune response and elucidate the potential molecular regulatory mechanism of apoptosis, intestinal microflora, metabolism, inflammation, and immune response-mediated miRNA–target gene axis in cyprinid fish.
statement: 建议miRNA可能与肠道菌群合作调节肠道炎症和免疫反应，并阐明鲤科鱼类中由凋亡、肠道菌群、代谢、炎症和免疫反应介导的miRNA-靶基因轴的潜在分子调控机制。
text_zh: 建议miRNA可能与肠道菌群合作调节肠道炎症和免疫反应，并阐明鲤科鱼类中由凋亡、肠道菌群、代谢、炎症和免疫反应介导的miRNA-靶基因轴的潜在分子调控机制。
text_en: It is suggested that miRNAs may cooperate with the gut microbiota to regulate intestinal inflammation and immune responses, and to elucidate the potential molecular regulatory mechanisms of miRNA-target gene axes mediated by apoptosis, gut microbiota, metabolism, inflammation, and immune responses in cyprinid fish.

quote: Most previous studies have focused on factors that control healthy intestinal microflora, such as diet, feeding conditions, and fish genes (72).
statement: 大多数以前的研究集中在控制健康肠道菌群的因素上，如饮食、饲养条件和鱼类基因。
text_zh: 大多数以前的研究集中在控制健康肠道菌群的因素上，如饮食、饲养条件和鱼类基因。
text_en: Most previous studies have focused on factors controlling a healthy gut microbiota, such as diet, rearing conditions, and fish genetics.

quote: Low diversity and stability of microbiota are closely associated with fish diseases (12 , 13 , 55).
statement: 微生物群落的低多样性和稳定性与鱼类疾病密切相关。
text_zh: 微生物群落的低多样性和稳定性与鱼类疾病密切相关。
text_en: Low diversity and stability of microbial communities are closely associated with fish diseases.

quote: A great deal of evidence showed that improving the diversity of fish intestinal microbiota can more effectively protect the host against pathogen invasion (56 – 58).
statement: 大量证据表明，提高鱼类肠道微生物群的多样性可以更有效地保护宿主免受病原体入侵。
text_zh: 大量证据表明，提高鱼类肠道微生物群的多样性可以更有效地保护宿主免受病原体入侵。
text_en: A large body of evidence indicates that increasing the diversity of the fish gut microbiota can more effectively protect the host against pathogen invasion.

quote: In this study, the composition of the intestinal microflora of crucian carp changed significantly after infection with R. aquatilis , with the relative abundance of Cetobacterium first increasing significantly and then decreasing.
statement: 本研究发现，感染R. aquatilis后，鲫鱼的肠道菌群组成发生显著变化，其中Cetobacterium的相对丰度先显著增加后减少。
text_zh: 本研究发现，感染R. aquatilis后，鲫鱼的肠道菌群组成发生显著变化，其中Cetobacterium的相对丰度先显著增加后减少。
text_en: This study found that after infection with R. aquatilis, the gut microbiota composition of crucian carp changed significantly, in which the relative abundance of Cetobacterium first increased significantly and then decreased.

quote: The study of the intestinal microflora of the grass carp Ctenopharyngodon idella showed that the relative abundance of Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes increased significantly, indicating that Bacillus subtilis plays a role in regulating the intestinal immune response, fat metabolism, and bacterial composition (60).
statement: 对草鱼肠道菌群的研究显示，变形菌门和拟杆菌门的相对丰度显著增加，表明枯草芽孢杆菌在调节肠道免疫反应、脂肪代谢和细菌组成方面发挥作用。
text_zh: 对草鱼肠道菌群的研究显示，变形菌门和拟杆菌门的相对丰度显著增加，表明枯草芽孢杆菌在调节肠道免疫反应、脂肪代谢和细菌组成方面发挥作用。
text_en: Research on the gut microbiota of grass carp showed that the relative abundance of Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes increased significantly, indicating that Bacillus subtilis plays a role in regulating intestinal immune responses, fat metabolism, and bacterial composition.
outcome: 肠道免疫反应、脂肪代谢、细菌组成

quote: By stimulating innate immunity and regulating the intestinal microflora, Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus reduced the abundance of pathogenic Aeromonas , decreased intestinal mucosal and epithelial cell damage, and improved the growth performance and survival rate of the mandarin fish Siniperca chuatsi (61).
statement: 通过刺激先天免疫和调节肠道菌群，蛭弧菌降低了致病性气单胞菌的丰度，减少了肠黏膜和上皮细胞损伤，并提高了鳜鱼的生长性能和存活率。
text_zh: 通过刺激先天免疫和调节肠道菌群，蛭弧菌降低了致病性气单胞菌的丰度，减少了肠黏膜和上皮细胞损伤，并提高了鳜鱼的生长性能和存活率。
text_en: By stimulating innate immunity and regulating gut microbiota, Bdellovibrio reduced the abundance of pathogenic Aeromonas, decreased intestinal mucosal and epithelial cell damage, and improved the growth performance and survival rate of mandarin fish.
outcome: 生长性能、存活率、肠道损伤、病原菌丰度

quote: In this study, the bacteriophyta Proteobacteria, Fusobacteria, Bacteroidetes, and Firmicutes were found to be predominant in the intestine of crucian carp, suggesting that R. aquatilis can cause intestinal flora disorder by affecting the changes in intestinal microecology and physiological metabolism, which then lead to intestinal pathology and immune response, but its immunomodulatory mechanism still requires further research.
statement: 本研究发现变形菌门、梭杆菌门、拟杆菌门和厚壁菌门在鲫鱼肠道中占优势，提示R. aquatilis可通过影响肠道微生态和生理代谢的变化引起肠道菌群失调，进而导致肠道病理和免疫反应，但其免疫调节机制仍需进一步研究。
text_zh: 本研究发现变形菌门、梭杆菌门、拟杆菌门和厚壁菌门在鲫鱼肠道中占优势，提示R. aquatilis可通过影响肠道微生态和生理代谢的变化引起肠道菌群失调，进而导致肠道病理和免疫反应，但其免疫调节机制仍需进一步研究。
text_en: This study found that Proteobacteria, Fusobacteria, Bacteroidetes, and Firmicutes were dominant in the gut of crucian carp, suggesting that R. aquatilis may cause dysbiosis of the gut microbiota by affecting changes in gut microecology and physiological metabolism, thereby leading to intestinal pathology and immune responses, but its immunomodulatory mechanism requires further study.
outcome: 肠道菌群失调、肠道病理、免疫反应
limitations: 免疫调节机制仍需进一步研究

quote: Before the formal trial, a prefeeding period was conducted for 4 weeks to acclimate to the feed and rearing conditions.
statement: 在正式试验前进行了为期4周的预饲喂期，以使鱼适应饲料和饲养条件。
text_zh: 在正式试验前进行了为期4周的预饲喂期，以使鱼适应饲料和饲养条件。
text_en: A 4-week acclimation period was conducted before the formal trial to allow the fish to adapt to the feed and rearing conditions.

quote: Fish of each strain with the similar weight (3.02 ± 0.82 g) were selected, weighted, and distributed into round fiberglass tanks at the density as 30 fish per tank.
statement: 选择体重相似（3.02 ± 0.82 g）的鱼，称重后以每缸30尾的密度放入圆形玻璃钢缸中。
text_zh: 选择体重相似（3.02 ± 0.82 g）的鱼，称重后以每缸30尾的密度放入圆形玻璃钢缸中。
text_en: Fish with similar body weight (3.02 ± 0.82 g) were selected, weighed, and then placed into circular fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks at a density of 30 fish per tank.

quote: The fish were fed to apparent satiation twice a day at 08 : 30 am and 14 : 30 pm
statement: 鱼每天上午8:30和下午2:30被喂食至表观饱食状态。
text_zh: 鱼每天上午8:30和下午2:30被喂食至表观饱食状态。
text_en: Fish were fed to apparent satiation daily at 8:30 AM and 2:30 PM.

quote: water temperature was 25.5 ± 1.5°C; light intensity was approximately 3 μ mol m −2 s −1 at the water surface; light period was from 08 : 00 am to 20 : 00 pm; water dissolved oxygen was more than 5 mg L −1 ; water ammonia nitrogen was
statement: 水温为25.5 ± 1.5°C；水面光照强度约为3 μmol m−2 s−1；光照时间为上午8:00至晚上20:00；水中溶解氧大于5 mg/L；水中氨氮为...（原文截断）。
text_zh: 水温为25.5 ± 1.5°C；水面光照强度约为3 μmol m−2 s−1；光照时间为上午8:00至晚上20:00；水中溶解氧大于5 mg/L；水中氨氮为...（原文截断）。

quote: water dissolved oxygen was more than 5 mg L −1 ; water ammonia nitrogen was less than 0.5 mg L −1 ; and water residual chloride was less than 0.01 mg L −1 (weekly monitored).
statement: 溶解氧高于5 mg/L，氨氮低于0.5 mg/L，余氯低于0.01 mg/L，并每周监测。
text_zh: 溶解氧高于5 mg/L，氨氮低于0.5 mg/L，余氯低于0.01 mg/L，并每周监测。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen above 5 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen below 0.5 mg/L, residual chlorine below 0.01 mg/L, and monitored weekly.

quote: all fish in each tank were weighed after 24 h of food deprivation
statement: 在禁食24小时后对每个水箱中的所有鱼进行称重。
text_zh: 在禁食24小时后对每个水箱中的所有鱼进行称重。
text_en: All fish in each tank were weighed after a 24-hour fast.

quote: They were anesthetized by MS-222 (100 mg L −1 tricaine methane sulfonate, Argent Chemical Laboratories Inc., Redmond, WA, USA).
statement: 使用MS-222（100 mg/L 三卡因甲磺酸盐）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 使用MS-222（100 mg/L 三卡因甲磺酸盐）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized using MS-222 (100 mg/L tricaine methanesulfonate).

quote: Propionic acid may be produced by Proteobacteria, which could act as an HDAC inhibitor and thereby promote the release of the anti-inflammatory factor TGF-β , which plays an important role in the regulation of intestinal inflammation (80 , 81).
statement: 变形菌门可能产生丙酸，丙酸可作为HDAC抑制剂，从而促进抗炎因子TGF-β的释放，后者在调节肠道炎症中起重要作用。
text_zh: 变形菌门可能产生丙酸，丙酸可作为HDAC抑制剂，从而促进抗炎因子TGF-β的释放，后者在调节肠道炎症中起重要作用。
text_en: Proteobacteria may produce propionic acid, which can act as an HDAC inhibitor, thereby promoting the release of the anti-inflammatory factor TGF-β, which plays an important role in regulating intestinal inflammation.

quote: However, the optimal levels of dietary carbohydrates for fish are usually lower than those of other domestic animals due to their poor ability to regulate glucose homeostasis after carbohydrate intake [ 1 ].
statement: 由于鱼类在摄入碳水化合物后调节葡萄糖稳态的能力较差，其日粮中碳水化合物的最佳水平通常低于其他家养动物。
text_zh: 由于鱼类在摄入碳水化合物后调节葡萄糖稳态的能力较差，其日粮中碳水化合物的最佳水平通常低于其他家养动物。
text_en: Because fish have a poor ability to regulate glucose homeostasis after carbohydrate intake, the optimal level of carbohydrates in their diet is usually lower than that of other domesticated animals.

quote: Carnivorous fish such as white sturgeon (Acipenser transmontanus) could better use maltose or glucose than dextrin, raw cornstarch, or sucrose diets [ 3 ].
statement: 白鲟等肉食性鱼类能更好地利用麦芽糖或葡萄糖，而不是糊精、生玉米淀粉或蔗糖日粮。
text_zh: 白鲟等肉食性鱼类能更好地利用麦芽糖或葡萄糖，而不是糊精、生玉米淀粉或蔗糖日粮。
text_en: Carnivorous fish such as the Chinese paddlefish can better utilize maltose or glucose diets than dextrin, raw corn starch, or sucrose diets.

quote: Alarmingly, postprandial plasma glucose was negatively correlated with SGR, FE, PRE, and LRE
statement: Postprandial plasma glucose was negatively correlated with specific growth rate, feed efficiency, protein efficiency ratio, and lipid retention efficiency.
text_en: Postprandial plasma glucose was negatively correlated with specific growth rate, feed efficiency, protein efficiency ratio, and lipid retention efficiency.
outcome: 生长性能与饲料利用率

quote: a carbohydrate-enriched diet causes fatty liver in fish, thus increasing mortality and decreasing their growth performance
statement: A carbohydrate-enriched diet causes fatty liver in fish, which increases mortality and decreases growth performance.
text_en: A carbohydrate-enriched diet causes fatty liver in fish, which increases mortality and decreases growth performance.
outcome: 脂肪肝、死亡率与生长性能

quote: A significantly faster growth of both crucian carp and brown trout was observed on the adjusted lakes and streams in comparison to the control group ones.
statement: 在调整后的湖泊和溪流中，鲫鱼和褐鳟的生长速度显著快于对照组。
text_zh: 在调整后的湖泊和溪流中，鲫鱼和褐鳟的生长速度显著快于对照组。
text_en: In adjusted lakes and streams, the growth rate of crucian carp and brown trout was significantly faster than that of the control group.

population.system: 小型砾石坑湖和小溪流

quote: Trout and carp prospered on small streams and gravel pit lakes (respectively) that were free of angling, fish stocking, pollution, piscivorous predators, and competition with hybridizing species like Prussian carp (Carassius auratus , L.) or hatchery‐reared brown trout.
statement: 在没有垂钓、鱼类放养、污染、食鱼捕食者以及与杂交物种（如普鲁士鲤或孵化场饲养的褐鳟）竞争的小型溪流和砾石坑湖中，鳟鱼和鲤鱼繁盛。
text_zh: 在没有垂钓、鱼类放养、污染、食鱼捕食者以及与杂交物种（如普鲁士鲤或孵化场饲养的褐鳟）竞争的小型溪流和砾石坑湖中，鳟鱼和鲤鱼繁盛。
text_en: Trout and carp thrive in small streams and gravel pit lakes without angling, fish stocking, pollution, piscivorous predators, or competition from hybrid species (such as Prussian carp or hatchery-reared brown trout).

quote: The experimental habitats were adjusted for the experiment (Table S2) using the techniques that are generally accepted to fit the ecological niche of the studied species and positively affect their populations
statement: 实验栖息地采用了通常被认为适合研究物种生态位并对其种群产生积极影响的技术进行调整。
text_zh: 实验栖息地采用了通常被认为适合研究物种生态位并对其种群产生积极影响的技术进行调整。
text_en: The experimental habitats were adjusted using techniques generally considered suitable for the ecological niche of the study species and having a positive impact on their populations.
outcome: 种群健康与生态适应性

quote: In this study, an in situ experiment on crucian carp and brown trout populations was performed to test whether specific habitat adaptations corresponding to the species‐specific requirements can result in higher growth rates of local fish populations.
statement: 本研究对鲫鱼和褐鳟种群进行了原位实验，以测试符合物种特定需求的特定栖息地适应是否能导致当地鱼类种群更高的生长率。
text_zh: 本研究对鲫鱼和褐鳟种群进行了原位实验，以测试符合物种特定需求的特定栖息地适应是否能导致当地鱼类种群更高的生长率。
text_en: This study conducted in situ experiments on crucian carp and brown trout populations to test whether specific habitat adaptations meeting species-specific needs could lead to higher growth rates in local fish populations.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (crucian carp), 褐鳟 (brown trout)

quote: It was hypothesized that the studied fish populations would grow faster and therefore prosper more in the adjusted habitats in comparison to the control group habitats.
statement: 假设与对照组栖息地相比，所研究的鱼类种群在调整后的栖息地中生长更快，因此更加繁荣。
text_zh: 假设与对照组栖息地相比，所研究的鱼类种群在调整后的栖息地中生长更快，因此更加繁荣。
text_en: Assume that the studied fish population grows faster in the adjusted habitat compared to the control group habitat, and therefore thrives more.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (crucian carp), 褐鳟 (brown trout)

quote: The study hypothesis was confirmed, as the fish densities and growth rates were higher on the adjusted sites in comparison to the control ones.
statement: 研究假设得到证实，即调整后的地点与对照地点相比，鱼类密度和生长率更高。
text_zh: 研究假设得到证实，即调整后的地点与对照地点相比，鱼类密度和生长率更高。
text_en: The research hypothesis was confirmed, namely that adjusted sites had higher fish density and growth rates compared to control sites.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (Crucian carp) 和褐鳟 (Brown trout)
population.system: 砾石坑湖和小溪流 (gravel pit lakes and small streams)

quote: The fish were handled, transported, and released carefully to ensure their maximum wellfare through the entire operation.
statement: 鱼类在操作过程中被小心地处理、运输和释放，以确保其在整个过程中的最大福利。
text_zh: 鱼类在操作过程中被小心地处理、运输和释放，以确保其在整个过程中的最大福利。
text_en: Fish are carefully handled, transported and released during the procedure to ensure their maximum welfare throughout the process.

quote: Each time the site was surveyed, the caught fish were measured, weighed, and released back to water.
statement: 每次调查站点时，捕获的鱼被测量、称重并放回水中。
text_zh: 每次调查站点时，捕获的鱼被测量、称重并放回水中。
text_en: At each survey site, captured fish were measured, weighed, and released back into the water.

quote: After the studied gravel pit lakes and small streams were adjusted to fit the ecological niche of crucian carp and brown trout (respectively), we observed that both species prospered significantly better on adjusted streams and lakes with optimal environmental conditions
statement: 在调整砾石坑湖和小溪流以符合鲫鱼和褐鳟生态位后，观察到这两个物种在具有最佳环境条件的调整水域中繁荣得更好。
text_zh: 在调整砾石坑湖和小溪流以符合鲫鱼和褐鳟生态位后，观察到这两个物种在具有最佳环境条件的调整水域中繁荣得更好。
text_en: After adjusting gravel pit lakes and small streams to match the ecological niches of crucian carp and brown trout, these two species were observed to thrive better in the adjusted waters with optimal environmental conditions.

quote: fish, thus increasing mortality and decreasing their growth performance [ 29 ].
statement: 某因素导致鱼类死亡率增加和生长性能下降。
text_zh: 某因素导致鱼类死亡率增加和生长性能下降。
text_en: A certain factor led to increased fish mortality and decreased growth performance.

quote: Previous successful restoration projects of brown trout populations in western and northern Europe showed that trout needs naturally meandering and unpolluted streams without excessive angling pressure, stocking of non‐native fish (mainly rainbow trout O. mykiss), or otter predation pressure.
statement: 先前的成功修复项目表明，褐鳟需要自然蜿蜒且未受污染的溪流，且没有过度的垂钓压力、非本地鱼类（主要是虹鳟）的放养或水獭捕食压力。
text_zh: 先前的成功修复项目表明，褐鳟需要自然蜿蜒且未受污染的溪流，且没有过度的垂钓压力、非本地鱼类（主要是虹鳟）的放养或水獭捕食压力。
text_en: Previous successful restoration projects indicate that brown trout require naturally meandering and unpolluted streams, without excessive angling pressure, stocking of non-native fish (mainly rainbow trout), or otter predation pressure.

quote: The streams need to contain both deep parts (0.5 m) and shallow parts (with fast water) for hiding and spawning.
statement: 溪流需要包含深水区（0.5米）和浅水区（急流），以供躲藏和产卵。
text_zh: 溪流需要包含深水区（0.5米）和浅水区（急流），以供躲藏和产卵。
text_en: Streams need to include deep water areas (0.5 meters) and shallow water areas (rapids) for hiding and spawning.

quote: These parts need to be connected to allow migration, meaning that any barrier higher than 0.5 m disallows smooth trout migration.
statement: 这些区域需要相互连接以允许迁徙，这意味着任何高于0.5米的障碍都会阻碍鳟鱼的顺畅迁徙。
text_zh: 这些区域需要相互连接以允许迁徙，这意味着任何高于0.5米的障碍都会阻碍鳟鱼的顺畅迁徙。
text_en: These areas need to be interconnected to allow migration, which means that any barrier higher than 0.5 meters will hinder the smooth migration of trout.

quote: A source of allochthonous insect prey needs to be available because trout feeds primarily on allochthonous insects (Louison & Stelzer, 2016 ; Machordom et al., 1999).
statement: 必须提供外源性昆虫猎物来源，因为鳟鱼主要以这种昆虫为食。
text_zh: 必须提供外源性昆虫猎物来源，因为鳟鱼主要以这种昆虫为食。
text_en: Exogenous insect prey sources must be provided, as trout primarily feed on this type of insect.

quote: It was found that studied fish had higher fish densities and faster growth on the adjusted sites in comparison to the control sites.
statement: 研究发现，与对照站点相比，调整后的站点上研究鱼类的密度更高且生长速度更快。
text_zh: 研究发现，与对照站点相比，调整后的站点上研究鱼类的密度更高且生长速度更快。
text_en: The study found that the density of the studied fish was higher and their growth rate was faster at adjusted sites compared to control sites.

quote: This confirmed the initial hypothesis that the carps and trout would prosper more on the adjusted sites.
statement: 这证实了最初的假设，即鲤鱼和鳟鱼在调整后的站点上会繁荣得更好。
text_zh: 这证实了最初的假设，即鲤鱼和鳟鱼在调整后的站点上会繁荣得更好。
text_en: This confirmed the initial hypothesis that carp and trout would thrive better at the adjusted sites.

quote: Alkalinized and saline-alkalized waters can disrupt the acid-base balance and inhibit the excretion of nitrogen-containing wastes, which are fatal to the growth and reproduction of freshwater fish in these extreme environments
statement: 碱化和盐碱化水域会破坏酸碱平衡并抑制含氮废物的排泄，这对这些极端环境中的淡水鱼类的生长和繁殖是致命的。
text_zh: 碱化和盐碱化水域会破坏酸碱平衡并抑制含氮废物的排泄，这对这些极端环境中的淡水鱼类的生长和繁殖是致命的。
text_en: Alkaline and saline-alkaline waters disrupt acid-base balance and inhibit the excretion of nitrogenous wastes, which is fatal to the growth and reproduction of freshwater fish in these extreme environments.

quote: In the case of crucian carp, we chose small and shallow gravel pit lakes (under 2 m deep with maximum of 150 m 2 of water surface) because crucian carps require predator‐free waters, but they do not require a large water body.
statement: 选择小型浅水砾石坑湖是因为鲫鱼需要无捕食者的水域，但不需要大的水体。
text_zh: 选择小型浅水砾石坑湖是因为鲫鱼需要无捕食者的水域，但不需要大的水体。
text_en: Small, shallow gravel pit lakes were selected because crucian carp require predator-free waters but do not need large water bodies.

quote: We chose lakes with sufficient oxygen levels (0.5–0.7 mg/L), suitable temperature (12–20°C), and average pH and conductivity to ensure that carps do not suffocate or get intoxicated.
statement: 选择具有足够氧气水平、适宜温度以及平均pH值和电导率的湖泊，以确保鲫鱼不会窒息或中毒。
text_zh: 选择具有足够氧气水平、适宜温度以及平均pH值和电导率的湖泊，以确保鲫鱼不会窒息或中毒。
text_en: Select lakes with sufficient oxygen levels, suitable temperature, and average pH and conductivity to ensure that crucian carp do not suffocate or become poisoned.
outcome: 生理健康（窒息/中毒风险）

quote: The lakes were located far (at least 100 m) from human settlements to avoid direct interaction with humans.
statement: 湖泊位于远离人类定居点的地方，以避免与人类的直接互动。
text_zh: 湖泊位于远离人类定居点的地方，以避免与人类的直接互动。
text_en: The lake is located far from human settlements to avoid direct interaction with humans.

quote: It is because crucian carps are often taken as bait fish by anglers, and they suffer from stocking of competitive and predatory fishes.
statement: 这是因为鲫鱼常被垂钓者作为饵鱼捕获，并且它们因竞争性鱼类和掠食性鱼类的放养而遭受痛苦。
text_zh: 这是因为鲫鱼常被垂钓者作为饵鱼捕获，并且它们因竞争性鱼类和掠食性鱼类的放养而遭受痛苦。
text_en: This is because crucian carp are often caught by anglers as bait fish, and they suffer due to the stocking of competitive and predatory fish.
intervention_record: 避免放养竞争和掠食鱼类

quote: In the case of crucian carp, small and shallow pit lakes (under 150 m 2 and 2 m of depth) located in a forest proved to be suitable for carps.
statement: 对于鲫鱼而言，位于森林中的小型浅坑湖（面积小于150平方米且深度为2米）被证明是适合的。
text_zh: 对于鲫鱼而言，位于森林中的小型浅坑湖（面积小于150平方米且深度为2米）被证明是适合的。
text_en: For crucian carp, small shallow pit lakes located in forests (with an area of less than 150 square meters and a depth of 2 meters) have been proven to be suitable.

quote: Some of the adversary effects were out of hands of the managers—for example, if the water quality in the stream changed due to an emission of pharmaceutical or organic pollutants into the water, the trout population perished as well.
statement: Changes in water quality due to pharmaceutical or organic pollutant emissions caused trout populations to perish.
text_en: Changes in water quality due to pharmaceutical or organic pollutant emissions caused trout populations to perish.

quote: A total of 180 F1 hybrids were randomly assigned to 6 identical aquariums and raised under the same feeding conditions with standard feeding procedures.
statement: 将180尾F1代杂交鱼随机分配到6个相同的水族箱中，并在相同的饲养条件下按照标准程序进行喂养。
text_zh: 将180尾F1代杂交鱼随机分配到6个相同的水族箱中，并在相同的饲养条件下按照标准程序进行喂养。
text_en: 180 F1 generation hybrid fish were randomly assigned to 6 identical aquariums and fed according to standard procedures under the same rearing conditions.

quote: NaHCO 3 was added to each aquarium in equal amounts at a gradient of 20 mM/L per day.
statement: 每天向每个水族箱中等量添加碳酸氢钠，梯度为20 mM/L。
text_zh: 每天向每个水族箱中等量添加碳酸氢钠，梯度为20 mM/L。
text_en: Sodium bicarbonate was added in equal amounts to each aquarium daily, with a gradient of 20 mM/L.

quote: The aim of the study was to investigate the effects of CLS on the growth performance, microflora and intestinal morphology in crucian carp Carassius auratus.
statement: 本研究旨在调查铜负载硅酸盐（CLS）对鲫鱼生长性能、菌群和肠道形态的影响。

text_en: This study aimed to investigate the effects of copper-loaded silicate (CLS) on growth performance, microbiota, and intestinal morphology of crucian carp.

quote: In order to control bacterial infections in aquaculture systems, a great deal of research has been carried out on microbial ecological agents and various antibiotics such as chloramphenicol, oxyte-tracycline, chlortetracycline (CTC), flavophospholipol and virginiamycin.
statement: 为了控制水产养殖系统中的细菌感染，人们针对微生物生态制剂和多种抗生素进行了大量研究。
text_zh: 为了控制水产养殖系统中的细菌感染，人们针对微生物生态制剂和多种抗生素进行了大量研究。
text_en: To control bacterial infections in aquaculture systems, extensive research has been conducted on microbial ecological preparations and various antibiotics.

quote: However, long-term application and misuse of these have resulted in the development of drug resistant bacteria (Aoki et al. 1972), immunosuppression (Rijkers et al. 1980) and drug residue in aquatic products (Schwarz et al. 2001), and can potentially have a detrimental effect on the environment.
statement: 长期应用和滥用这些药物导致了耐药菌的产生、免疫抑制以及水产品中的药物残留，并可能对环境产生有害影响。
text_zh: 长期应用和滥用这些药物导致了耐药菌的产生、免疫抑制以及水产品中的药物残留，并可能对环境产生有害影响。
text_en: Long-term use and abuse of these drugs have led to the emergence of resistant bacteria, immunosuppression, and drug residues in aquatic products, and may have harmful effects on the environment.
outcome: 健康与环境影响（耐药性、免疫抑制、残留）

quote: The height of the villi in the proximal, mid and distal intestine mucosa of the silicate- and CLS-treated groups was found to be longer (p = 0.05) compared with the villi of the control or the CTC-treated fish.
statement: Silicate- and CLS-treated groups had longer intestinal villi heights in the proximal, mid, and distal intestine mucosa compared to control or CTC-treated fish.
text_en: Silicate- and CLS-treated groups had longer intestinal villi heights in the proximal, mid, and distal intestine mucosa compared to control or CTC-treated fish.

quote: Supplementation with CuSO4 had no effect on the microflora and the intestinal morphol-ogy (p = 0.05).
statement: CuSO4 supplementation had no effect on microflora and intestinal morphology.
text_en: CuSO4 supplementation had no effect on microflora and intestinal morphology.

quote: These results indicate that CLS had an antibacterial activity in vivo, which may help protect the intestinal mucosa from invasion of pathogenic bacteria and their toxins.
statement: Results indicate CLS has antibacterial activity in vivo, potentially protecting intestinal mucosa from pathogenic bacteria and toxins.
text_en: Results indicate CLS has antibacterial activity in vivo, potentially protecting intestinal mucosa from pathogenic bacteria and toxins.
outcome: 肠道黏膜保护/抗菌活性

quote:
At the end of
the feeding trial, 9 fish were randomly selected from
each treatment (n = 3 per tank), anesthetized with tri-
caine methanesulfonate (MS-222, Sigma) and then
killed.
statement: 在饲养试验结束时，从每个处理组随机选取9条鱼（每缸3条），使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）麻醉后处死。
text_zh: 在饲养试验结束时，从每个处理组随机选取9条鱼（每缸3条），使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）麻醉后处死。
text_en: At the end of the feeding trial, 9 fish (3 per tank) were randomly selected from each treatment group and euthanized after anesthesia with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222).

quote:
Total counts of aerobic bacteria were measured
from carp skin by putting a 5 × 5 cm sterile template on
the fish surface (in the central region) and swabbing
this area enclosed by the template.
statement: 通过将5×5厘米的无菌模板放置在鱼体表面（中央区域）并擦拭该区域，测量鲤鱼皮肤上的需氧菌总数。
text_zh: 通过将5×5厘米的无菌模板放置在鱼体表面（中央区域）并擦拭该区域，测量鲤鱼皮肤上的需氧菌总数。
text_en: Total aerobic bacteria on carp skin were measured by placing a sterile 5×5 cm template on the fish body surface (central area) and wiping that area.

quote: Compared with the control, ADWG of carp fed with the diet supplementation with CLS increased and FCR decreased slightly (p > 0.05).
statement: 与对照组相比，饲喂补充CLS的饲料后，鲤鱼的平均日增重增加，饲料系数略有下降（p > 0.05）。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，饲喂补充CLS的饲料后，鲤鱼的平均日增重增加，饲料系数略有下降（p > 0.05）。
text_en: Compared with the control group, feeding carp a diet supplemented with CLS increased average daily gain and slightly decreased the feed conversion ratio (p > 0.05).

quote: Similar results were also found in the silicate-treatment and CTC-treat-ment groups.
statement: 在硅酸盐处理组和CTC处理组中也发现了类似的结果。
text_zh: 在硅酸盐处理组和CTC处理组中也发现了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results were also found in the silicate treatment group and the CTC treatment group.

quote: Total counts of aerobic bacteria, Vibrio, E. coli and Lactobacilli on the skin and gill were not affected by the supplemen-tation of CuSO4, silicate, CLS or CTC.
statement: CuSO4、硅酸盐、CLS或CTC的补充对鲤鱼皮肤和鳃上的需氧菌总数、弧菌、大肠杆菌和乳杆菌数量没有影响。
text_zh: CuSO4、硅酸盐、CLS或CTC的补充对鲤鱼皮肤和鳃上的需氧菌总数、弧菌、大肠杆菌和乳杆菌数量没有影响。
text_en: Supplementation with CuSO4, silicate, CLS or CTC had no effect on the total number of aerobic bacteria, Vibrio, E. coli and Lactobacillus on the skin and gills of carp.
outcome: 体表及鳃部微生物群落

quote: Briefly, fishes and crayfish were anaesthetized using 2-phenoxyethanol.

text_zh: 鱼类和甲壳类动物使用2-苯氧乙醇进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish and crustaceans are anesthetized using 2-phenoxyethanol.

quote: This indicates that the dietary addition silicate or CLS may improve carp’s intestinal mucosal morphology.
statement: 膳食添加硅酸盐或CLS可能改善鲤鱼的肠道黏膜形态。
text_zh: 膳食添加硅酸盐或CLS可能改善鲤鱼的肠道黏膜形态。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with silicates or CLS may improve the intestinal mucosal morphology of carp.

quote: Montmorillonite protects intestinal muco- sa and can increase the intestinal mucosal barrier and help in the regeneration of the epithelium; it effec- tively acts by attaching to the mucus to preserve the mucosa from toxic effects of drugs and toxins (Alben- gres et al. 1985).
statement: 蒙脱石保护肠黏膜，增加肠黏膜屏障并帮助上皮再生；它通过附着在黏液上有效作用，以保护黏膜免受药物和毒素的毒性影响。
text_zh: 蒙脱石保护肠黏膜，增加肠黏膜屏障并帮助上皮再生；它通过附着在黏液上有效作用，以保护黏膜免受药物和毒素的毒性影响。
text_en: Montmorillonite protects the intestinal mucosa, increases the intestinal mucosal barrier and helps epithelial regeneration; it works effectively by attaching to mucus to protect the mucosa from the toxic effects of drugs and toxins.
outcome: 肠道黏膜屏障与上皮再生

quote: Thus, the positive effect of silicate or CLS on intestinal mucosal morphology may be explained by the substances’ antimicrobial activity and mucosa-enhancing function.
statement: 因此，硅酸盐或CLS对肠道黏膜形态的积极影响可能由其抗菌活性和增强黏膜功能来解释。
text_zh: 因此，硅酸盐或CLS对肠道黏膜形态的积极影响可能由其抗菌活性和增强黏膜功能来解释。
text_en: Therefore, the positive effects of silicate or CLS on intestinal mucosal morphology may be explained by their antibacterial activity and enhancement of mucosal function.

quote: Percent survival was 100%.

text_en: However, dietary supplementation with CLS had no significant effect on the microbiota of carp skin or gills.
outcome: 体表及鳃部微生物群落
